spans.s: गौर (I) a. (f. रा or री) 1. White, तुषारगौरार्पितहारशेखराः Rt.i.6, R.ii.35, Megh.i.52; 2. yellowish, त्वं रोचनागौरशरीरयष्टिः R.vi.65; 3. reddish; 4. shining, brilliant, pure, clean, beautiful.
गौर (II) m. 1. The white colour; 2. the yellowish colour; 3. the reddish colour; 4. white mustard; 5. the moon; 6. a kind of deer.
गौर (III) n. 1. The filament of a lotus; 2. saffron; 3. gold.
गौर (I) a. (f. रा or री) 1. White, तुषारगौरार्पितहारशेखराः Rt.i.6, R.ii.35, Megh.i.52; 2. yellowish, त्वं रोचनागौरशरीरयष्टिः R.vi.65; 3. reddish; 4. shining, brilliant, pure, clean, beautiful.
गौर (I) a. (f. रा or री) 1. White, तुषारगौरार्पितहारशेखराः Rt.i.6, R.ii.35, Megh.i.52; 2. yellowish, त्वं रोचनागौरशरीरयष्टिः R.vi.65; 3. reddish; 4. shining, brilliant, pure, clean, beautiful.

गौरी f. 1. A name of Pārvatī; 2. a young girl eight years old; 3. a young girl prior to menstruation; 4. a woman with a white or yellowish complexion; 5. the earth; 6. turmeric; 7. a yellow dye (called गोरोचना); 8. the wife of Varuṇa; 9. the mallikā creeper.
गौर-आस्य m. a kind of black monkey with a white face.
गौर-सर्षप m. the white mustard.
गौरक्ष्य n. The office of a herdsman.

गौरव n. 1. Weight, heaviness, सुरेंद्रमात्राश्रितगर्मगौरवात् R.iii.11; 2. importance, high value, high estimation, R.xiv.18, xviii.19; 3. cumbrousness; 4. respect, regard, respectability, dignity, कोऽर्थी गतो गौरवम् Panch.i. or प्रायश्चलं गौरवमाश्रितेषु K.S.iii.1, Am.
; 5. depth (of meaning), यच्चार्थतो गौरवम् M.M.i.; 6. length (of a syllable) (in prosody).
गौरव-आसन n. a seat of honour.
गौरव-ईरित a. praised, famed.
गौरवित a. (f. ता) Highly esteemed or valued.
गौरवित a. (f. ता) Highly esteemed or valued.
गौरिका f. A virgin, a young girl.
गौरिल m. 1. White mustard; 2. dust of iron or steel.
गौरी-कांत, -नाथ m. an epithet of Śiva.
गौरी-कांत, -नाथ m. an epithet of Śiva.
गौरी-गुरु m. the Himālaya mountain, गौरीगुरोर्गह्वरमाविवेश R.ii.26, Kir.v.21.
गौरी-ज (I) m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
गौरी-ज (II) n. talc.
गौरी-पट्ट m. the horizontal plate of the Linga typical of the female organ.
गौरी-पुत्र m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
गौरी-ललित f. a yellow orpiment.
गौरी-सुत m. 1. the son of a girl married when 8 years old; 2. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
गौरुतल्पिक m. The violator of the bed of a preceptor.
